title: Golden Swap Experiment Atlas

experiments.title: q4-multigpu
experiments.reason: Original Q4 capacity, K24 ownership and runtime characterization; aggregate measurements only.

experiments.title: q4-pool-spin
experiments.reason: Contemporary ordinary pool-100us baseline and repeatability context; aggregate only.

experiments.title: q4-residency-v2
experiments.reason: Native Q4 demand traces, history/early admission, modeled future-feasible and capacity-free references.

experiments.title: q4-conditional-admission
experiments.reason: Pre-staging rejection and persistent-copy funnel; natural ON/OFF work may diverge.

experiments.title: q4-live-oracle
experiments.reason: First full-work live record/replay with future demand, real transfers and five charged spares.

experiments.title: q4-oracle-decomposition
experiments.reason: Matched incoming/victim information restrictions; E64 is routed invocations, I/V are windows.

experiments.title: golden-swap-phase0
experiments.reason: Twelve natural corpus recordings with initial state and native service journals.

experiments.title: golden-swap-phase1
experiments.reason: Frozen victim prediction, ranking metrics and unprotected admission lifetimes.

experiments.title: golden-swap-phase2
experiments.reason: First-use control, matched history/logistic, OFF/ON and independent finite-tail tapes.

experiments.title: golden-swap-phase3
experiments.reason: Planner memoization and corrected publication chronology; history/TC fixed.

experiments.title: golden-swap-phase4-publication-wait
experiments.reason: Eight retained CONTROL/TRACE requests; symmetric perturbation gate failed.

experiments.title: Original IQ3_S / K25 record-demand replay
experiments.reason: Earliest byte-aware recorded-demand then future-nextuse and transfer-free simulation. Not Q4 or live throughput.
